title: An invoiced split work order shows both names as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" reading {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reading {Sales-rep-B}; it has just been invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, read the labels of Lead Technician, Service Advisor and both Sales Representative fields.
  2. Hover over the Sales Representative rows.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep the labels an invoiced work order shows today ("Lead technician" and "Service advisor"); only the two representative fields read "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", each with its name under it.
  • Step 2: "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B} show as plain text, with no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.
  • Step 3: nothing opens; the representatives cannot be changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”
  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 8: “8. (a) Lead technician and Service advisor stay as they are today; only the Sales Representative fields use the new labels.”
